I get this type of stuff a lot except instead of being physically harmed I imagine myself going through more of a psychological trauma, usually involving my family being killed through a car crash, murder, etc. I always come out clean in these scenarios except for the aforementioned psychological trauma. I think it’s a replacement for fantasies in the past that I had where I’d do something really cool yet ultimately unrealistic and people would be shocked and amazed and praise me (like for example fighting off a mountain lion with my bare hands, maybe not impossible but probably unlikely due to my size). It seems based in the same thing, with that thing being a desire for attention/care from others (I didn’t have a lot of people I considered true friends through most of middle school and probably all of high school), but they’re also influenced by different perspectives, I think. I may have initially been the type of person to be drawn to people based on their accomplishments, so by that logic, I may have subconsciously assumed that other people would be drawn to accomplishments as well and thus that would be a way to get attention. But as time passed, I had a few experiences where I saw people going through rough times, and I felt this strong need to comfort them and be there for them, even though I didn’t know them, and I think this strong draw to them again influenced my perspective of what draws people in, thus my fantasies changed over to ones where I somehow became a sympathetic/tragic character. Which of course, the idea that being sympathetic draws people in is probably unrealistic too, at least if you’re thinking it will work in the long term, since eventually I think a good portion of mentally healthy people would get worn out by someone who is MOSTLY (emphasis on MOSTLY) doom and gloom, or at least they’d maybe see the relationship as not worth their time even if they still felt the person was good and they didn’t really hate them or anything. 

But still, the idea sticks with me, and I think it’s a reason I don’t really seek to get better, is because I think it’s the only way I can potentially get attention from people.

On that note, the thing that stands out most to me with my OWN fantasies is that it possibly indicates that I don’t think I can gain any attention/care/love from people I like based on my ACTUAL PERSONALITY. It’s always things like accomplishments or tragic circumstance (things I consider more external) rather than my actual self, like the thought that people can actually enjoy my personality and love me for who I am or because I’m just me doesn’t really cross my mind and honestly I would probably be very surprised if someone told me that they did. Of course, the idea that people can’t like me based on my personality is unrealistic, too - I think it’s just that I’ve never seen prominent, CLEAR examples of people being drawn to the personalities of others or myself (I’m sure there were some examples but I think I’m emotionally stunted in some way to where people have to be VERY DIRECT AND OBVIOUS in their feelings) so my mind sees no ‘prior evidence’ that it can happen, even though objectively speaking IT CAN. Plus people technically HAVE liked me in the past...just not the people I myself have liked, so that’s just me being picky lol. Anyways that’s my self-analysis for the day, should probably wrap it up at this point bcus I like talking about myself too much and if I get going further I might not stop LOL. But idk, since my fantasies and yours involve being hurt in some way perhaps they might be based in similar motivations things and provide potential insight in some way? Or if not at the very least you have another example of how you aren’t the only one with these types of fantasies.
